create_GenerativeDecoder: create a GenerativeDecoder instance with config params for transformer or LSTM text encoding
run_forward_pass: run the forward pass of GenerativeDecoder to compute token-level cross-entropy loss over a batch
run_beam_search: run beam search decoding on GenerativeDecoder for multi-round conversational batch generation
run_single_beam_search: run beam search decoding on GenerativeDecoder for a single instance with configurable beam size
backtrack_beams: backtrack beam search tokens through reverse indices to reconstruct top candidate sequences
